subject: Function-identifier
notes: SR1 (cite.py --check 8.4.3.2.3 'A function-identifier shall not be specified as a receiving operand' -> OK §8.4.3.2.3 1)). The receiving grammar rules do not admit functionCall, and ArithmeticSendingOperandDriftTests guards that. Where a slot is format-dependent, the binder screens it (INSPECT gets COBOL1632; ADD TO without GIVING gets COBOL1689). Probes out/probe/function-identifier/p12_sr1_00..11: MOVE TO, STRING INTO, INSPECT REPLACING, INITIALIZE, ADD TO, ACCEPT, UNSTRING INTO, SET, COMPUTE target, UNSTRING COUNT IN and DIVIDE REMAINDER are ALL refused. INSPECT FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(W) TALLYING N (Format 1, sending) compiles, which is correct. Several refusals are the generic COBOL0001 parse error rather than a named SR1 diagnostic, which is diagnostic quality only. || editions as written by the adjudicator: 1985 (Amendment 1), 2002, 2014, 2023 - applies to every function-identifier. Annex E (2014->2023) lists no change to 8.4.3.2
